summary: Chilwa Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching its October 19, 2026 ASX announcement that Maxim Group LLC, sole underwriter of its US Nasdaq IPO, partially exercised the over-allotment option. Maxim bought 56,834 ADSs (568,340 ordinary shares) at US$5.59 per ADS — the US$5.60 IPO price less US$0.01 for the attached warrant — for gross proceeds of US$317,702 (about A$0.45 million), net US$292,286, closing October 16, 2026. Total US offering proceeds now approximate US$3.82 million; 104,922,682 shares are outstanding, with 35,166 ADSs and 92,000 warrants available until the November 16, 2026 expiry.
